description: This file implements an example IPC server and client using socket pairs, demonstrating remote procedure calls with protobuf serialization, including a service that echoes text in uppercase and a main program that spawns a client process and manages IPC communication.

classes.name: MyExampleService
classes.description: A service implementation that provides an example echo method, converting input text to uppercase and returning it.

methods.name: exampleEcho
methods.description: Handles an RPC call to echo a string in uppercase, responding via the provided response object.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when the RPC call completes, setting the 'done' flag to true.

methods.name: childProcessMain
methods.description: Main function for the child process that creates an IPC channel, makes an example RPC call, and handles the response.

methods.name: spawnClient
methods.description: Forks and executes a child process, passing it a socket for IPC communication.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a client disconnects, logging client process and user IDs.
